title: 5a PRD: core model redesign
description:
Write the capability PRD for the core model redesign (L0 + storage + adapter interface). Consumes the brainstorm decisions from sutra/29.

Scope:
- Ephemeral/durable storage partition (single DB, table-level, name-based refs, reconciliation)
- LanguageAdapter trait + FcaAttributeSource extension trait
- ParseContext: core owns tree-sitter, adapter does extraction
- Tree-structured ParseResult (replaces flat list + parent_qualified_name)
- language_attrs JSON column for language-specific structured data
- Signature (human display) vs language_attrs (machine readable) split
- Evolution path as 5 sequential PRs

Input: sutra/29 decisions, docs/sutra-architecture.md, docs/sutra-vision.md, current codebase
Output: docs/prd/core-model.md ready for decompose into implementation slices"
